Marta (BlueHarbor CFO): Quick heads up 121212 procurement flagged that the renewal invoice needs to be issued to BlueHarbor EU Ltd. and they want SSO confirmed before they release the PO. Can we get that sorted by next Wednesday?
Ivy (CSM): Thanks Marta 12 noted. Can you confirm whether procurement will accept a PO (net45) or if they insist on wire/CC? Also need the exact legal entity line for the contract.
Derek (Finance): We can invoice BlueHarbor EU Ltd. but well need VAT registration + exact legal name and address. PO + net45 is fine. If they want card we can accommodate but procurement usually blocks card for renewals.
Marta (BlueHarbor CFO): They will only do PO. VAT: IE987654321. Legal name: "BlueHarbor EU Ltd." Address: "1 Harbour Road, Dublin, IE".
Priya (Legal): Ok, we need to produce a short addendum to swap billing entity. That addendum will likely require a signature from the EU signatory. How soon can they sign?
Marta (BlueHarbor CFO): Marta (me) can sign but procurement still needs to issue the PO. Theyre aiming EOD Fri.
Sam (Solutions Eng): For SSO we need IdP metadata (EntityID, SSO URL, x509 cert). If they use Azure AD we just need the federation metadata url. We can do a staged rollout: create accounts with email auth for enablement, then flip SAML once metadata is live. That avoids blocking training.
Ivy (CSM): Perfect. I'll prepare a renewal quote with a note for the entity swap and include a 30-day grace period in case PO delays. Derek 12 any constraints from finance about holding pricing?
Derek (Finance): We can hold price for 7 days post-renewal if PO arrives late; otherwise we'll need to re-quote. We can also accept a signed addendum and provisional PO number to lock the price.
Priya (Legal): I'll draft the addendum today and upload to DocSend. Does BlueHarbor prefer e-sign or wet signature for the EU entity?
Marta (BlueHarbor CFO): E-sign is fine. Procurement just needs SSO confirmation before they turn the PO over.
Sam (Solutions Eng): Can you confirm their IdP type?
Marta (BlueHarbor CFO): Azure AD. Federation metadata: https://login.microsoftonline.com/blueharbor/federationmetadata/2007-06/federationmetadata.xml. I'll DM the cert if needed.
Ivy (CSM): Seat count confirmation: renewing 90 seats; 10 will be moved off after month 1 (so effective net 80 month 2). Will reflect on the quote.
Derek (Finance): Noted 12 we'll prorate the 10 seats for the second month. Please confirm effective date.
Ivy (CSM): Target renewal date: 2026-05-01. If PO not received by 2026-05-08 we hold price for 7 days per Derek. Addendum + e-sign to be completed before or on renewal date.
Priya (Legal): Addendum uploaded: https://docsend.example/xyz987. I replaced the billing clause and added signature block for BlueHarbor EU Ltd. Waiting on Marta to e-sign.
docsend-bot: uploaded blueharbor_addendum_v1.pdf 12 https://docsend.example/xyz987
Marta (BlueHarbor CFO): Signed e-sign completed. Procurement will send PO by EOD Fri per our internal tracker.
Derek (Finance): Received signed addendum. Once PO arrives, AR will generate invoice net45 to BlueHarbor EU Ltd. Seat adjustments noted for prorate.
Sam (Solutions Eng): I'll open a support ticket for SSO setup and provision org with email auth for enablement week of 2026-05-04. Flip to SAML once metadata validated. Please add me to the procurement ticket when PO is out.
Ivy (CSM): I'll send a single summary to everyone (procurement cc'd) with next steps and timelines, include quote id Q-49012-EU and the docsend link. If anything slips, we have the 30-day extension option as a fallback. :thumbsup:
